Return 1 on the named-parameter success path.
If PAUSEStringCopier returns nonzero, take the numeric fallback success path.
v7 = a4 (captured value); *a3 = 0; a3[1] = v7. Writes flag 0 and the resolved value into the caller's DWORD pair.
Return 1 on the fallback success path.
Return 0 when both lookup strategies fail.
